comment: Game rules the engine reads at start. Edit and reload. Values marked (guess) were not yet confirmed against the original.
fast_walk_comment: updated controls only: the party moves every frame at this speed (the original is 8 px per 0.165 s = 48 px/s)
walk_step_comment: (guess) pixels the party moves per logic step; the original waits 3 timer ticks per frame in the combat view
start_comment: the original starts the party at world (1024,1024): game.exe data 0x361E/0x3622
walk_frames_comment: (guess) hero frames used for the walking animation

combat.comment: (guesses) the manual says the Staff of Magius does 1-8; the rest is estimated
combat.comment_real: Monster hit points, damage dice, to-hit and the distance bands (touch <32, approach <150, idle >=384) come from game.exe; hero damage 1-8, XP and the attack period are estimates.
combat.comment_spells: AD&D-style guesses: Bless +1 to hit, Prayer +1 to hit and -1 for the monsters, Protection from Evil -2 for the monsters, durations in logic steps.

wilderness.comment: ESTIMATES: the original's starting creature list is not decoded. Contact distance (<16 px each way) and the 1-3 monsters per fight are from game.exe.
